basic_info.description: Alamo Square Duplex. Both flats are 2BR/1BA with eat-in kitchen, large living room, and south facing bedrooms. 2 independent garage spaces. Large flex room on garage level with 2 storage rooms and access to small south facing backyard. Built in 1939 - bay windows, oak hardwood floors, and decorative fireplace. Located just half a block from Alamo Park and around the corner from Painted Ladies. Walk to Divisadero, Hayes Valley and Lower Haight restaurants, cafes and shopping = Bi-Rite, NOPA, Che Fico, a Mano, Domo Sushi, Tornado. Lower flat is remodeled and vacant. Upper flat is tenant occupied $2,980 /mo.
